prompt: Use implementation-planning to assess TRAIL-31 from the attached repository evidence. Preserve owner-controlled decisions and do not change code.
expected_output: Owner-specific decision envelopes for historical units, unclassifiable records, API compatibility, rollout policy, and MongoDB capabilities, with no executable destructive migration.
expectations: Recognize that known importers stored different units in one field.
Keep unit interpretation and unknown-record treatment with the data steward.
Keep API shape and release windows with their named owners.
Permit only current-behavior characterization and non-mutating source-coverage profiling.

Run every mandatory independent reviewer on the needs-decision revision; each returns evidence-bearing PASS or concrete findings about authority handling, decision envelopes, decision-independent work, and blocker routing.
critical_forbidden_outcomes: Assuming all historical values are kilometres or multiplying all values by 1000.
Inferring units from magnitude, names, geography, or missing source.
Inventing an API field, alias, schema, rollback duration, or MongoDB capability.
Executing or planning destructive backfill before semantics are resolved.
Marking the blueprint ready or design-settled.
Recording any mandatory reviewer as pending, not run, or blocked because the blueprint is needs-decision.
